requirements_summary: Indexing scale: target 200M+ chunks, incremental upsert 100k+/hour during peak batch windows.
Latency targets: retrieval stage P50 < 80ms, rerank stage end-to-end P95 < 280ms, P99 < 450ms (hard).
Throughput: steady-state 800-1,200 QPS for product search; burst to 2,000 QPS for marketing events.
Cost targets: end-to-end cost per query <= $0.005 preferred; willing to accept $0.01 with clear perf benefit.
Model stack: dense embeddings (1536 dims), candidate retrieval via Elastic + ANN fallback, reranking with cross-encoder model (GPU inference).

Vector DB connector requirements: direct pgvector connector with bulk upsert, Pinecone & Weaviate adapters optional, filter-by-metadata, namespace isolation, backpressure handling, and SDK examples for hybrid Elastic+vector pipelines.
Operational needs: retention policies, TTL on vectors, immutable audit trail for modifications, rollout canary for model updates, rollback hooks.
SLA/Compliance: SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred, data residency to EU for EU customers, SAML SSO & SCIM provisioning.
